people.name: Gebim
people.line: Town in Benjamin; mentioned in Isaiah's prophecy

translations.web: Madmenah is a fugitive. The inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety.
translations.bsb: Madmenah flees; the people of Gebim take refuge.
translations.kjv: Madmenah is removed; the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee.
translations.asv: Madmenah is a fugitive; the inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety.
